prompt_md: How many squares of any size, from single cells up to the whole board, can you find on an 8 by 8 chessboard?
prompt_short: Squares of every size on an 8 by 8 chessboard?
hint_md: How many 2 by 2 squares fit? How many 7 by 7?
explain_intuition_md: 64 counts only the single cells. There are also 49 two-by-two squares, 36 three-by-threes, and so on down to the one full board. The counts are the square numbers from 64 down to 1.
